# firezone_site (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Site by id or name. Exactly one of the two must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "firezone_site" "primary" {
  name = "primary-dc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Site ID. Set this or name, not both.
- `name` (String) Site name. Set this or id, not both. If more than one Site shares this name, the lookup fails - use id instead.
